public_observations.topic: AI CFD Scientist controlled post-execution verification
public_observations.observation: AI CFD Scientist reports a 20-case controlled verifier study: 16 planted silent failures plus 4 clean controls. The vision-language gate caught 14/16 planted failures (recall 87.5%); because all four clean controls were also flagged, precision was 14/18=77.8% and F1 82.4%. The authors attribute the clean false positives to an incomplete rendered evidence surface: the reviewer requirement referenced a deliverable not visible in the rendered subset.
public_observations.boundary: direct evidence for science-agent execution-result verification, not a matched failure-memory revalidation ablation

public_observations.topic: AI CFD Scientist public ablation implementation surface
public_observations.observation: The public run_vlm_ablation.py constructs controls from previously PROCEED'd production cases, renders diagnostic figures, and invokes quick_interpret.py with the requirement plus at most 12 PNGs. quick_interpret.py has only PROCEED/REVISE/RERUN terminal mappings: although it parses requirement_met and simulation_success, its status mapping is driven by rerun_required and has no HOLD/UNINSPECTABLE state. The prompt likewise asks the model to set rerun_required when results are not acceptable. Thus missing evidence can be operationally conflated with a negative result in this ablation path.
public_observations.boundary: current public main implementation inspected; do not assume identical bytes to every paper run without revision binding

protocol_inferences.name: candidate_vs_certified_mechanism_fingerprint
protocol_inferences.rule: Evidence provenance should distinguish a reconstructed/candidate paper-era mechanism fingerprint from a fingerprint explicitly certified as the evaluated implementation. Date adjacency and repository lineage narrow uncertainty but do not close evaluated-revision provenance.

protocol_inferences.name: VERIFIER_OBSERVABILITY_SCOPE
protocol_inferences.rule: A verifier may issue hard negative dispositions only when the claim's required evidence is bound and completely observable. Missing, partial, or uninspectable evidence must produce HOLD/REQUEST_EVIDENCE/UNINSPECTABLE rather than semantic contradiction. Verification is invalidated by evidence-surface or evidence-requirement digest drift.
